findings.title: Guard model changes on unusable sessions
findings.description: After a reconnect fails, `unusable_reason` is set, but `set_model()` does not check it before calling the client. The session dispatch path calls `set_model()` before `dispatch()`, where the unusable check does exist. A later step can therefore hit the failed client first and surface a transport error instead of the recorded unusable-session error. Check usability before changing the model, and cover that path with a test.

findings.title: Add a load test for background-agent waiting
findings.description: The changes add network-stream waiting, timeout cancellation, and background-task stopping, but the load-test suite has no coverage for this SDK session path. The required load test should exercise a realistic background-agent configuration and assert resource or latency bounds; the new unit tests cover scripted functional behavior, not those bounds.
